s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic multisystem inflammatory condition with skin, joint, and lymph node involvement
salient_findings: Gradual hair loss of the eyelashes, eyebrows, beard, and scalp
Swelling and painful hand joints
Multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms
Diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair
Elevated rheumatoid factor
Presence of acid-fast bacilli in skin biopsy
key_facts: Male patient in his 40s
4-year history of gradual hair loss
13-month history of swelling and painful hand joints
40-day history of multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms
No fever, analgesia, or hypesthesia reported
No previous infections, family history, or personal medical history of autoimmune diseases or psoriasis
Previous treatments for joint symptoms showed no improvements over 1 year
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate slightly elevated at 27 mm/h
Rheumatoid factor significantly elevated at 70.1 IU/mL
Normal results for C-reactive protein, anticyclic citrullinated peptide, antinuclear antibodies, and globulin levels
Osteoarthritis, synovitis, flexor tendon tenosynovitis, and bone erosions found on X-ray and joint ultrasound
Enlarged axillary, cervical, and inguinal lymph nodes and enlarged spleen found on ultrasound
Uveitis found on fundus fluorescein angiography
Skin biopsy from upper arm nodule showed diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present in skin biopsy

shortlist.label: Lepromatous leprosy
shortlist.why_kept: Numerous acid-fast bacilli present in skin biopsy and diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis

shortlist.label: Lupus vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic skin lesions and systemic involvement, including joint and lymph node symptoms

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and lymph node involvement, although no clear pulmonary symptoms

shortlist.label: Multibacillary leprosy
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to lepromatous leprosy, with skin and nerve involvement, and presence of acid-fast bacilli

shortlist.label: Erythema nodosum leprosum
shortlist.why_kept: Type of leprosy reaction that can occur in multibacillary leprosy, with skin nodules and systemic symptoms
